the four distinct bases (pl, q, p, and the two compound gPlayers forms) were each converted in place with their own spelling preserved, including the deliberate `gPlayers + player * 0x335C` literal stride which was NOT rewritten to sizeof(Player). claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction.20260831.v1 APPLIED as a prohibition: every stride/multiplicand (0x335C, *4, *132, *16) was left as a bare literal and no sizeof() was substituted. claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention.20260830.v1 APPLIED as a VETO and honored trivially: serve_blits' `e += 8` load-update web is on a blit base, touches none of these offsets, and was left completely untouched. claim.law.offsetof-rename-isolated-site-outlier.20260830.v1 APPLIED as method: seven separate gated batches rather than one bulk gate. claim.law.embedded-struct-member-whole-tu-cascade.20260831.v1 APPLIED: the enabling header edit was gated alone in phase 1 before any site here was touched. claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast.20260830.v1 and claim.law.write-site-alias-defeats-reload-parity.20260830.v1 NOT APPLICABLE: no alias introduced, read and write sites converted identically.
